The '''Drive Synchronization Module''' was a component used on [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards']] [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut]]. The module was connected to the drive [[Engine/Legends|engines]] which powered the vehicles drive [[wheel]]s.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
